title: Filter with eq and fetch one row
why_it_matters: Fetching one record by id is a daily task.
explanation: eq adds a where column = value filter. Chain more filters for more conditions. single returns one object instead of an array and gives an error if there isn't exactly one match. Perfect for a profile page.
code:
const { data, error } = await supabase
  .from("profiles")
  .select("*")
  .eq("id", userId)
  .single();
try_it: Call it with an id that doesn't exist and see the error.
